$schema-note: Single source of truth for the Netsession design system. Edit here, then run _build/build_all.ps1. Version must match CHANGELOG.md.

red-500.name: Netsession Rot
red-500.use: Primary brand colour. Accents, highlights, underlines, icons, red text on dark backgrounds.

red-600.name: Glut
red-600.use: Button / CTA fill (white text passes WCAG AA 4.5:1). Gradient end.

red-700.name: Rot Dunkel
red-700.use: Red text on white/light backgrounds, button hover/pressed, print on light paper.

ink-950.name: Nacht
ink-950.use: Main background (dark). Text and positive logo on light backgrounds.

ink-900.name: Tiefblau
ink-900.use: Secondary surfaces: content panel, newsletter body, alternating bands.

ink-600.name: Stahl
ink-600.use: Progress tracks, disabled fills, table header on dark.

gray-400.name: Nebel
gray-400.use: Muted / secondary text on dark (dates, captions).

gray-300.name: Silber
gray-300.use: Hairlines and secondary text on light; tertiary UI.

gray-100.name: Eis
gray-100.use: Body text on dark, negative logo, light surface tint.

white.name: Weiß
white.use: Paper, light backgrounds, text on red buttons.

info.name: Info
info.use: Neutral hints. Never as a brand accent.

danger.name: Fehler
danger.use: Errors. Same as red-500; pair with an icon so it is not confused with brand accents.

cta.use: Primary buttons on web (optional; flat red-600 is always acceptable).

glow.use: Subtle red glow behind hero titles on dark backgrounds.

display.use: Headlines, numbers, navigation, logo wordmark. Always UPPERCASE.

mono.use: Technical data: IPs, seat numbers, server names, code.

email.use: Newsletter body text (web fonts are unreliable in mail clients).

logo.clearspace: 1 key height (K) of the logo on all sides — for the vertical logo and banner, K = height of one key cap; for the signet alone use 0.5 K.
